appearance.colorSchemeDesc: Pick an accent color. Click "Save" — the color will be tied to your account and applied every time you sign in.
appearance.appBgDesc: A solid color or gradient instead of the standard "aurora". Soon you'll be able to set a background for each chat individually.

privacy.lastSeenDesc: Control who can see when you were last online.
privacy.hideLastSeenSub: Other users will see "offline" instead of the exact time
privacy.groupsDesc: Control who can add you to group chats.
privacy.noGroupAddLabel: Don't allow being added to groups
privacy.noGroupAddSub: No one will be able to add you to a group chat without your consent
privacy.avatarDesc: Control who sees your avatar in chats, in the contact list, and in your profile.
privacy.hideAvatarSub: Your avatar will only be visible to you. Others will see an initial instead.
privacy.exceptionsHint: Start typing a username to add an exception

permissions.pushConnectError: Couldn't connect push notifications. Try again.
permissions.blockedByBrowser: The browser blocked access. Allow it manually in your browser settings.
permissions.notificationsBlocked: The browser blocked notifications. Allow them manually in your browser settings.
permissions.cameraDesc: Needed to take photos and videos with the built-in camera.
permissions.microphoneDesc: Needed to record voice messages and videos with sound.
permissions.notificationsDesc: Lets you receive push notifications about new messages.
permissions.hint: Manage the permissions the site uses to power its features. If a permission is blocked by the browser, change it manually in your browser settings (the lock icon in the address bar).
permissions.blockedByBrowserShort: Blocked by the browser. Click the lock icon in the address bar to change it.
permissions.pushNotConnected: Notifications aren't connected. The subscription may have expired.

passkeys.unsupported: Your browser doesn't support passkeys (WebAuthn). Try Chrome, Safari, or Edge.
passkeys.description: Passkeys let you sign in without a password using your device's biometrics or PIN.

profileModal.title: Settings
profileModal.deleteConfirmText: This action is irreversible. All your direct chats will be deleted, you'll leave all groups, and your username will be freed up.

profile.newEmailHint: Enter a new email — a confirmation code will be sent to it

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.enabledHint: You'll need a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.) to sign in.
twoFactor.disabledHint: Two-factor authentication significantly improves account security. Once enabled, you'll need to enter a code from an authenticator app every time you sign in.
twoFactor.scanHint: Scan the QR code or enter the key manually in Google Authenticator, Authy, or another app.
twoFactor.backupCodesHint: Save these codes somewhere safe. Each code can only be used once.
twoFactor.disableHint: To disable 2FA, enter a valid TOTP code or one of your backup codes.
twoFactor.regenHint: Enter your current TOTP code to generate new backup codes. The old codes will become invalid.

exportData.contentMessagesDesc: All your chats with decrypted text
exportData.contentFriendsDesc: Your contacts and when they were added
exportData.contentSessionsDesc: Devices and IP addresses of your logins
exportData.hint: Under GDPR you have the right to get a copy of all your data. The archive is generated in real time and downloaded to your device right away.
exportData.archiveReady: Archive downloaded. The next export is available in an hour.
exportData.rateLimited: Limit reached. Export is available once an hour — try again later.
exportData.createError: Error creating the archive. Please try again.
exportData.formatNote: Format: ZIP archive with JSON files. Limit: 1 export per hour.

password.title: Password
password.digitOrSpecialError: Password must contain at least one digit or special character

documents.hint: The Privacy Policy and Terms of Use are available here anytime — no need to look them up elsewhere.
